{{short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{Infobox college sports team season |year=2009–10 |team=UTEP Miners |sport=Basketball |image=UTEP Miners wordmark.svg |conference=Conference USA |division= |short_conf=C-USA |CoachRank= |APRank= |record=26–7 |conf_record=15–1 |head_coach=[[Tony Barbee]] |asst_coach1=Randall Dickey |asst_coach2=[[Tony Madlock]] |asst_coach3=[[Milt Wagner]] |stadium=[[Don Haskins Center]] |champion=C-USA Regular Season Champions |tourney=[[2010 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] |tourney_result=Round of 64 }} {{2009–10 Conference USA men's basketball standings}} The '''2009–10 UTEP Miners men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Texas at El Paso]] in the [[2009–10 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2009–10]] [[college basketball]] season. This was head coach [[Tony Barbee]]'s fourth season at UTEP. The Miners competed in [[2009–10 Conference USA men's basketball season|Conference USA]] and played their home games at the [[Don Haskins Center]]. They finished the season 26–7, 15–1 in CUSA play to win the regular season championship. They advanced to the championship game of the [[2010 Conference USA men's basketball tournament]] before losing to [[2009–10 Houston Cougars men's basketball team|Houston]]. They received an at–large bid to the [[2010 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament]], earning a 12 seed in the west region, where they lost to 5 seed and AP #11 [[2009–10 Butler Bulldogs men's basketball team|Butler]] in the first round.
